message: よき理解者

name: Riesling
message: 「Good day」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!?」
When I happened to pass by the wharf, Miss Riesling pointed a pistol at me without a word of explanation.
Lolotte isn't anywhere around. Which means there's nobody here who can stop this?
I-I'm going to be killed……!!

name: Riesling
message: 「Forgive the abruptness, but do you have any experience shooting with a short barrel?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Am I safe?」

name: Riesling
message: 「In that case, I shall lend it to you, Lord Paqy」
Riesling hands two pistols to Paqy

name: Paqy
message: 「Hey, hey, isn't that a Saturday night pistol? With a piece of junk like this, the bullets won't even fly straight, y'know?」

name: Riesling
message: 「As we are anticipating an assault by ruffians, I deliberately selected that handgun」

name: Paqy
message: 「Well, I don't mind. The butler's weapon is actually decent, after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「I'm much obliged」

name: Synn
message: 「Uhh, I'm not quite following...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Excuse me, there is a message from Helena」

name: Riesling
message: 「Hello? Angels are number one, telephones are number two, and for your three o'clock sniping, this is Riesling Toyama speaking」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, it's Helena\s04」

name: Helena
message: 「Tamiko-chan, how are the preparations going on your end?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Leave the endurance test of the sister model to the young lady's chauffeur car to me, your humble butler, Riesling Toyama」

name: Helena
message: 「I'm all ready over here too. Ready to go?」

name: Helena
message: 「Classic Rocket Mode, boop♪」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-W-What is going on!?」
A massive hole blows open in the hull of a large transport ship moored at the pier, and a luxury car bursts out from inside.

name: Riesling
message: 「What you see over there is the Daydream Supercar Helena 2000 'Onifuji'」

name: Helena
message: 「Woohoo! The G-Canceler is working great」

name: Synn
message: 「D-Don't tell me Ms. Helena is inside that car...」

name: Riesling
message: 「Indeed she is.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait a minute, it's in free fall straight toward us!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「It has entered firing range. Commencing interception now.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on, hold on, hold on!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Alright, here it comes!」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Huh? The bullets are bouncing off...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa!?」

name: Riesling
message: 「Cease fire」

name: Paqy
message: 「Here you go, butler, take it back」

name: Helena
message: 「Hiii, I'm Helena, the righteous director revived in the modern age\s04」

name: Synn
message: 「H-Helena, are you hurt!?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ta-da! Not a scratch♪」

name: Paqy
message: 「Every shot hit dead-on, and instead of turning into Swiss cheese, not even the paint's chipped」

name: Helena
message: 「Well, of course! Tamiko-chan upgraded the body's molecular structure for me, after all」

name: Riesling
message: 「Inflicting damage upon it with modern weaponry is impossible」

name: Synn
message: 「J-just what kind of car is this?」

name: Helena
message: 「Ufufu, fitting for the commander of the Crusaders, isn't it? Plus, it's a custom stealth fighter!」

name: Helena
message: 「You can ride it too once you get your license, Synn-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Really? I'm looking forward to it」

name: Paqy
message: 「...Wanna ride it?」

name: Riesling
message: 「How was the handling?」

name: Helena
message: 「No issues with performance itself. There's a glitch in the language circuit, though. Sometimes Kito speaks in Kansai dialect」

name: Riesling
message: 「Do you like the Kansai dialect, Helena?」

name: Helena
message: 「My absolute favorite♪」

name: Riesling
message: 「In that case, there is no problem.」

name: Helena
message: 「Hehe, you're right about that. That's the end of the durability test!」

name: Helena
message: 「Come on, Synn-chan. I'll give you a ride home, hop in.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes!」

name: Riesling
message: 「...I pray for your continued fortune in battle, Master Synn. Excuse me.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh...? You're not getting in, Riesling-san? Well then, goodbye.」
I soon found out the reason why Riesling-san didn't get in....
